exposure: various surgical techniques of primary CS
cohort: 400 obstetricians with a diploma or degree in the specialty, performing C-sections, and willing to participate in the study from the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Mayo Institute of Medical Sciences, Barabanki, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India
finding: There was heterogeneity and variation in the CS techniques being practiced by the obstetricians, likely due to surgeon preferences, training, and difficulty unlearning established techniques.
